encounter:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: full-bleed 2D watercolor winter hiking encounter background for a browser game, landscape 1536x1024. No characters or animals: those are separate animated game layers.
Scene: Qinling winter forest on a snowy inner mountainside. Side-oblique eye-height view, not overhead and not aerial. A real grounded wide snow-covered mountain footpath crosses horizontally from left at y70% to right at y64%. Path has a flat walkable surface, about 9% of image height wide. Snowy ground CONTINUES DOWN to the bottom edge, connected to the hillside; never a bridge or hovering road, no void beneath.
Near foreground, left third: one visibly broad, flat inward snowy lay-by, from x8%-44%, y74%-91%, naturally connected to the main trail at x34%-45%. Its inner edge is beside low dark rocks with snow caps, roomy enough for a small hiker to retreat. This is a real natural platform, not a glowing circle or UI target.
Far right at x96%, tall snow-capped rock outcrop partly conceals the trail bend. Sparse conifers, deep-brown leafless brush, layered cool forest above path, subtle distant Qinling ridges and gray-white overcast sky. Keep enough open snow between x40% and x85% around y65% for a large dark animal, and small one behind near x92%.
Style: fine hand-painted watercolor with paper grain and delicate ink edges, natural lighting and depth, muted slate-green, cool white, umber rock, no glossy rendering, no thick outlines. Path edge, footprints and snow drifts are irregular, not a uniformly outlined geometric band. Calm wind, light snow, clear spatial readability.
No labels, icons, arrows, red markers, circles, tents, humans, animals, signage, text or watermark.
